name: Ding ivory glaze (warm white over porcelain)

diffuseAlbedo.source: Palette.json: accent.porcelain-glazed and accent.stoneware-glazed (Chenghuai's ceramics, the catalogue's media)
diffuseAlbedo.note: The Ding kilns' thin ivory glaze over a white porcelain body, warm where it pools in the carving: no measured colour was read: a first value read from museum photographs of the named ware.

refractiveIndex.source: Substances/low-iron-glass.json (1.523 for soda-lime float); a ceramic glaze is a soda-lime-alumina-silica glass of about the same index

porosity.note: A glaze is glass: it has no open pores.

wettingDepth.note: The depth whose pores govern the face's look when wet.

grain.note: The finest structure the face shows.

bed.note: The coarsest structure the face shows.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across one face.
